name: fhsw-battle_of_foy-cq-firearms-rec
description: FHSW Battle_Of_Foy Conquest with the server-side recorder, no bots: two sidecar soldiers on the US side (kit 0, the officer's Thompson and Colt; kit 1, the bayonet Garand, Knife_M1Bayonet_ID2 and GrenadeAllies) press fire, alt-fire, reload and the item keys on a timed script, so the server's own shots and animation states say what FireArms does with each press (fh-fhsw-open-issues FHR-1, FHR-3 to FHR-5; features/fh-fhsw-open-issues/lab-firearms.md). human: No client: run the probe (two sidecar sessions, tools/bf1942-models/lab/firearms_probe.mjs) against the server, then `lab.py stop`.
